result.question: Why did leprosy break out on Uzziah?

readings.answer: Because the LORD had afflicted him.
readings.support: because the LORD had afflicted him

assessments.reason: The passage says “because the LORD had afflicted him,” which is equivalent in meaning to “Yahweh struck him.”

result.reason: The text explicitly attributes Uzziah’s leprosy to the LORD afflicting him, matching the key’s “Yahweh struck him.”
